cooccurrence: A major-deviation cell (`deviation-major-bg`, filled `deviation-major-badge-bg`) next to the danger button (`critical-bg-strong`) and a "Blocked" chip (`critical-bg-strong`). Dark: 1.56:1 between cell and button, separated by shape and label; the filled badge stands 3.15:1 from the button fill.
The TEST indicator (`env-test-*`) next to a critical banner (`critical-*`): violet against red; distinct icons (`science`, `error`) and words.

Minor (`deviation-minor-bg`), major (`deviation-major-bg`) and no-reference (`no-reference-bg`) cells in one column: major is lighter than minor (dark 1.37:1, light 1.22:1, high contrast 1.30:1); minor and no reference are close in lightness (about 1.06:1) and are told apart by the dashed `no-reference-border`, the icons `compare_arrows` / `fiber_new` and the labels.

Confidence borders (`confidence-confirm-border`, `confidence-correct-border`, `confirmed-border`, `user-entered-border`) on any deviation background: all hold 3:1 against every deviation background; they are told apart from each other by icon and label (lightness between them 1.1–1.3:1).

Generic feedback and findings severity (`success`, `info`, `caution`, `critical`, `neutral`): all foregrounds sit in the same lightness band because each must hold 4.5:1 on the dark surfaces; icon and word carry the difference. `success` is a bluish green, so success and critical do not collapse to one hue for protan and deutan viewers in the dark theme; in the light theme they collapse for deutan viewers (1.0:1), so the icon and the word are mandatory there.
The focus ring (`focus-ring`) on every deviation background, the selection tint and the hover tint: at least 3:1 in every theme.
